d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

To function as a Commis 1 for Calo Qatar's On-Demand QSR Kitchen. Support the kitchen team by executing daily preparation, cooking, and assembly tasks to meet Calo’s nutritional and speed standards. The successful candidate will play a critical role in maintaining high production efficiency and ensuring every order leaves the kitchen accurately prepared and on time.
Works under the guidance of senior chefs and CDPs in the Section
Works closely with the Kitchen Management, Production Leads to support workflow efficiency and production consistency
Shift based work, based in high volume environments with mandatory personal protective equipment during all production operation times
q: Proven experience as a Commis 2 or Commis 1 in QSR or high-volume restaurants (3 - 4 years minimum)
Proficient with basic health and safety, HACCP standards (certification preferred)
Understanding of basic preparations and cooking techniques
Ability to work in a fast paced, high volume production environment
Proficient with communication in English and working in a team
Passion for quality and continuous improvements
Able to be a team player for your peers and be the best version of yourself
Obsession with delivering a high level of customer satisfaction
r: Execute cooking, assembly, and preparations with consistency and efficiency in a fast-paced environment
Follow daily production and service plans to ensure the timely delivery of prepared hot meals
Align with the fast-paced nature of QSR service while maintaining Calo's quality and nutritional guidelines
Ensure precise portioning to align with Calo’s calories and macronutrient guidelines
Minimize waste through effective practice of storage, labeling and rotation of ingredients along with smart yield optimization
Maintain routine due diligence checks adhering to HACCP standards along with sanitation and safety protocols

d: We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented General Accountant to handle daily accounting operations, payroll processing, production-related transactions, and other financial activities. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting knowledge and hands-on experience with ERP systems.
q: Minimum 7 years of relevant accounting experience.
r: Prepare and post customer invoices and delivery notes in the ERP system.
Record and post production transactions in the ERP system.
Prepare and post month-end closing journal vouchers (JVs).
Prepare monthly payroll and salary statements.
Calculate and process employee and drivers' overtime.
Verify and post supplier invoices in the ERP system.
Verify and post material receipt transactions.
Maintain and regularly update prepaid expense schedules and related accounting records.
Prepare cheques for supplier payments and other company expenses.
Prepare commercial invoices in accordance with Letter of Credit (LC) requirements.
Prepare and process applications for opening import Letters of Credit (LCs) in favour of suppliers.
Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned by the Manager.

d: Project Manager – Luxury Development - Client Representative | Developer Role

We are looking for a highly experienced Project Manager – Client Representative to oversee premium luxury real estate developments and protect the client’s interests throughout the full project lifecycle.
Senior Project Managers from reputed main contractors seeking to transition into a client-side role with strong exposure to luxury/high-end developments.
Proven Client-side Project Managers from reputed real estate developers with experience managing high-value luxury projects.
The selected candidate will be responsible for ensuring delivery excellence across cost, time, quality and stakeholder management.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent
12–18 years of total experience in the construction/real estate sector
Strong experience in luxury villas, premium residential towers, luxury hotels or upscale mixed-use developments
Deep understanding of contracts, variations, claims, and commercial controls
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
Experience working with leading UAE developers
Deep expertise in reviewing contractor engineering submissions.
Exceptional ability to oversee quality assurance through detailed site inspections.
Strong leadership and communication skills to coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders.
Proficient in handling complex project timelines and delivering on objectives.
Ability to manage high-pressure, high-value projects.
r: Act as the primary client representative throughout the project lifecycle
Lead coordination between consultants, contractors and internal stakeholders
Oversee construction execution to ensure quality, safety and compliance standards
Review and approve engineering submissions, shop drawings and material submittals
Monitor project progress, risks and timelines , ensuring on-time delivery
Manage variations, claims and contractual matters in line with project objectives
Conduct regular site inspections and enforce quality benchmarks aligned with luxury standards

d: To plan, coordinate, and supervise daily transport and delivery operations to ensure safe, timely, and cost-effective distribution of products while maximizing fleet and manpower utilization. The role will also deputize for the Transport Manager in their absence.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or equivalent.
Minimum 5 years of experience in transport, fleet, logistics, or delivery operations, including supervisory responsibilities.
Strong knowledge of transport, fleet, and last-mile delivery operations.
Experience in route planning, dispatch management, POD/COD control, and fleet utilization.
Knowledge of TMS, GPS tracking, transport compliance, and HSE requirements.
Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
High level of ownership, initiative, and customer service orientation.
r: Plan and allocate vehicles, drivers, helpers, and equipment to meet daily operational requirements.
Optimize fleet and manpower productivity while controlling transport costs.
Coordinate with warehouse and operations teams for smooth dispatch execution.
Plan daily routes and vehicle loading to maximize delivery efficiency.
Ensure deliveries are completed within agreed SLAs.
Coordinate with customers, warehouse teams, and internal stakeholders to resolve delivery issues.
Monitor delivery progress and take corrective actions when required.
Ensure accurate loading, dispatch, and delivery of products.
Minimize delivery discrepancies, damages, and stock variances.
Verify and reconcile customer returns and rejected deliveries.
Ensure timely collection and reconciliation of COD payments.
Ensure all PODs are captured in TMS/DMS systems and archived properly.
Ensure vehicles are roadworthy and comply with company and regulatory requirements.
Conduct vehicle inspections and monitor maintenance schedules.
Ensure adherence to transport SOPs, safety standards, and quality requirements.
Monitor fuel consumption, vehicle productivity, and fleet performance.
Supervise drivers, helpers, and Customer service Associates.
Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and performance.
Conduct regular training and performance reviews.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly transport performance reports.
Monitor operational KPIs and recommend process improvements.
Support cost-saving and productivity improvement initiatives.
